newsitem.title: USA: National Pipe and Plastics files for Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: National Pipe and Plastics files for Chapter 11.

text.p: National Pipe and Plastics Inc filed for Chapter 11 protection Wednesday in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware.
The employee-owned company listed assets of $15.2 million and liabilities of $35.8 million, of which $17.2 million is in unsecured debt, most of it trade.
The company, based in Vestal, New York, manufactures PVC pipe for the plumbing, sewer, water and electrical industries. It has a plant in Greensboro, North Carolina.
